default.comment: UDP transport for connectionless, ordered delivery
TCP transport for connection-oriented, reliable delivery

entries.description: List of RPC network configuration entries; each defines a protocol family, transport type, protocol number, protocol name, and device path.

value.description: Space-separated configuration fields: transport type, protocol family (e.g., 16 for AF_INET), protocol name (e.g., 'udp'), and device path (e.g., '/dev/udp')

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment describing the entry (displayed above the line in config)
